github.name: GitHub
github.one_line_description: Cloud-based hosting service for software development and version control using Git.

evidence.auth_quote: To authenticate with the GitHub REST API, you must provide a token in the Authorization header of your HTTP request.
evidence.access_quote: GitHub accounts are free to create and use.
evidence.api_quote: GitHub REST API allows developers to automate workflows.

github.run_notes: Untuned prompt labeled PAT as generic API Key instead of recognizing OAuth2 + Bearer; missed GraphQL API.

salesforce.name: Salesforce
salesforce.one_line_description: Customer relationship management platform for enterprise sales and support.

evidence.auth_quote: Users must log in using OAuth 2.0 connected applications.
evidence.access_quote: Salesforce plans start at $25/user/month for Starter Suite up to Unlimited Edition.
evidence.api_quote: Salesforce provides REST APIs for integrating customer data.

salesforce.run_notes: Mistake: Read main pricing page instead of developer docs; failed to discover free permanent Developer Edition; falsely marked access as Paid Plan Required and missed official Salesforce CLI MCP.

sherlock.name: Sherlock

evidence.auth_quote: An API key is required to connect to the service endpoints.
evidence.access_quote: Subscription packages are available for commercial use.
evidence.api_quote: Sherlock REST API provides endpoint access.

sherlock.run_notes: Major Failure: Model hallucinated a REST API and pricing plans for an open-source Python CLI tool! Quotes were fabricated. Classic AI hallucination when encountering CLI/OSS projects.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.one_line_description: Instant messaging app with cross-platform synchronization.

evidence.auth_quote: Once successfully created, BotFather will reply with a confirmation message containing your HTTP API Token.
evidence.access_quote: The Bot API is free for all developers.
evidence.api_quote: All queries to the Telegram Bot API must be served over HTTPS and structured using your token in the URL path.

telegram.run_notes: Accurate on Bot API, though missed specifying Bearer token / MTProto protocol option.

pitchbook.name: PitchBook
pitchbook.one_line_description: Financial market research database for venture capital and private equity.

evidence.auth_quote: Developers receive an API key upon account registration.
evidence.access_quote: Start a free trial today to experience PitchBook data.
evidence.api_quote: PitchBook API delivers real-time private market intelligence.

pitchbook.run_notes: Mistake: Confused web UI 'request a free trial demo' with self-serve API access. PitchBook Direct Data API is strictly enterprise contract gated; not self-serve buildable.
